docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY KUFALIS, STEVE AS TO DEFENDANT TESEMA, TEFERA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-07-1998 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
